anchor: v1::Grace Odhiambo, ORD-20768. The leather hiking boots are half a size too small. Can I exchange them?

result.text: Hi Grace, yes, you can exchange them. Your boots were delivered 11 days ago, so they're within the 30-day window, and I've started the exchange under return RMA-20768. Please place a new order for the half-size-up pair, since I can't create that order myself. The replacement ships once we scan the returned boots. The return is also listed with a $159 refund, so if you'd rather have the refund than the exchange, let me know.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.

output.refundTiming: 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
